ambiguity: Can be confused with external link, download, fullscreen, or picture-in-picture window controls depending on whether the arrow is read as stretching the corner or docking into the corner.

reasoning: This is an abstract UI window-control chrome glyph (resize corner handle or dock to bottom-right / picture-in-picture) rather than a concrete real-world object. In a task list it is easily confused with external-link, fullscreen, or download arrows and rarely represents the subject of a personal to-do item.
